content.text: I reviewed the full agreement (single-section MSA, 75 paragraphs) and searched for MFN-style triggers ("most favoured/favored", "no less favorable", "best terms", "pricing") — no hits.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or price/terms-matching obligation running against us. Searches for "most favoured/favored", "no less favorable", "best terms" and "pricing" returned nothing, and the only commercial terms provisions (§1 Kubient Services and §5 Fees and Payment) set revenue share by Exhibit without any requirement that Customer extend to Kubient terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or match third-party offers. To the contrary, §1 expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves our right to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties, which is consistent with (and reinforces) the preferred position of no MFN burden on Customer. No Vendor-granted MFN exists either, but the playbook does not require one, so this sits at the preferred position and no redline is warranted.
